## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 accurately identifies ar5iv corruption but does not provide the required verbatim equations (8)–(10) or Definition 2.1.
- claims-2 and claim-3 support only the surviving theorem linkage; they cannot substitute for the missing extraction.
- claim-4 records that no alternate-provider full text was supplied, confirming that the explicit non-ar5iv retrieval requirement remains unmet.
- claim-5 correctly states that the named source certificate is not established. No alternate-provider URL, digest, stable locators, or complete bounded excerpt is present.

## Unresolved certificates
- [source-refresh] Retrieve source-29 from native arXiv or publisher full text and provide a digested, bounded verbatim excerpt containing equations (8)–(10), every Definition 2.1 inequality, Lemma 2.5, and Theorems 4.4–4.5, with stable locators and a separation of valid-tuple theorem hypotheses from the two proof branches in Theorem 4.4.
